nodes.body: Ports do not have to be defined on part defs. They can be added directly to their usages.
The ends of an interface definition are always ports.
This 'driveshaft' is the part of 'vehicle1_c1' that will act as the interface medium in the following 'DriveshaftInterface' usage.
The two rear wheels of 'rearAxleAssembly' must be given their own names in order to be referenced in connections. (":>" is a shorthand here for "subsets".)
If the part def has no ports, then they can be defined directly in a usage of the part def.
